newsitem.title: UK: Coconut oil lower at European vegetable oil close.
newsitem.headline: Coconut oil lower at European vegetable oil close.

text.p: Coconut oil prices finished lower on Friday on the European vegetable oil market in a repeat performance of the previous day's trading.
However, losses were not as marked with closing sellers only $10 to $2.50 down, but traders said major players were again selling cif material and buying fob.
The remainder of the market was quiet with business winding down ahead of the long holiday weekend.
Most of Europe will be closed on Monday May 16 for the Whitsun holiday, but the UK will be working normally.

Palm oil looks set to fall with traders in Asia in pessimistic mood following the release on Thursday of lower than expected Malaysian palm oil export figures for April by the Malaysian Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA).
PORLA put April exports at 570,067 tonnes against trade expectations of 600,000 to 610,000 tonnes.
By the close palm oil prices had shed a further $2.50 to $5 on the day with crude palm oil cif Europe and RBD palm oil both $2.50 to $7.50 down in neglected markets.
Olein finished unchanged after Jun traded at $585 and $582.50 and Jul at $572.50 and $570 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Coconut oil closed $10 to $2.50 lower after May/Jun traded at $647.50 and $645.00, Jun/Jul at $642.50, Jul/Aug at $637.50 and Aug/Sep at $632.50 and $635 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil offers were $5 to $2.50 higher with no business reported.

Soft oils closed with soy oil 0.50 guilders up to unchanged after Jun traded at 101 guilders and rape oil finished unchanged to 0.75 guilders lower after Aug/Oct traded at 102.50 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
